posts.title: SwiftUI @State Is Now a Macro in Xcode 27 - Lazy Initialization and Migration
posts.description: Learn how the SwiftUI State macro in Xcode 27 initializes state lazily, why observable models are now created only once, and how to fix the source incompatibilities it introduces.

posts.title: #file vs #filePath in Swift Tests - Cleaner, Cacheable Builds
posts.description: Learn when to use #file, #fileID, and #filePath in Swift tests. Keep absolute paths out of your build artifacts and get more cache hits on CI.

posts.title: XCTUnwrap in Swift - Stop Force Unwrapping in Unit Tests
posts.description: Learn how XCTUnwrap replaces force unwrapping in Swift unit tests, reporting a clear failure when an optional is nil instead of crashing your test suite.
